packages.label: רוּת וּתְפִלָּה
packages.reason: Rut is identified as bchinat tefillah — she is the aspect of prayer, because from her descended David who saturated (rivah) the Holy One with songs and praises. This is the tefillah/prayer side of the secret of semichat geulah l'tefillah. Both Rut and tefillah belong to the domain of holiness.
merge_notes: Small component (2 nodes). Considered merging with Package 2 (Boaz/Go'el), but the connection between geulah and tefillah is semicha (juxtaposition/structural joining), not shared essential nature. Boaz-Rut are a pair, but their bechina identities point to different domains (redemption vs. prayer). Kept separate per the rule: merge by shared nature only, not cause-and-effect or structural linkage.
packages.good_evil_mirror: No evil mirror present in this torah. The teaching is fragmentary — Rebbe Nachman delivered a full torah to a visiting rav, but only these bechina identifications were transmitted to R' Noson.

packages.label: בֹּעַז וּגְאֻלָּה
packages.reason: Boaz is identified as bchinat go'el (redeemer), as stated explicitly: 'ki go'el anokhi' (Ruth 3:12). This is the geulah/redemption side of the secret of semichat geulah l'tefillah. Both Boaz and go'el belong to the domain of holiness.
merge_notes: Small component (2 nodes). Considered merging with Package 1 (Rut/Tefillah), but the link between the two pairs is semichat geulah l'tefillah — a structural/halachic joining of two distinct domains, not a shared-nature bechina identity. Kept separate.
packages.good_evil_mirror: No evil mirror present in this torah. The teaching is fragmentary.
